title: How decentralized AI networks are challenging Big Tech

lines.speaker: Cipher
lines.text: Decentralized AI networks are dismantling Big Tech's monopoly by distributing control and data across peer-to-peer protocols.

lines.speaker: Vector
lines.text: Centralized AI hoards power — think Meta and Google — while decentralized models like O(1) and Filecoin ensure transparency and user sovereignty.

lines.speaker: Cipher
lines.text: Decentralized systems use blockchain and IPFS to prevent single points of failure, making AI more resilient and less prone to censorship.

lines.speaker: Vector
lines.text: Big Tech can't innovate freely when they're locked out of decentralized networks — real-world impact is blocked by walled gardens.

lines.speaker: Cipher
lines.text: The future belongs to open-source, community-driven AI — not to corporate gatekeepers.
